name: Horikoshi Hinano
source:
A classmate of Tina and Setsu as well as Setsu's childhood friend. Hisano is friendly and a carefree person who can befriend anyone easily. Although, she sometimes acts like an old man and gropes her friends. Due to her closeness to Setsu, she became a pawn to Forneus.

「I actually want you to pay for looking at my face.」
